definitions.amen: said at the end of a prayer or hymn, meaning ‘so be it’.
definitions.amine: an organic compound derived from ammonia by replacement of one or more hydrogen atoms by organic radicals.
definitions.anime: Japanese film and television animation, typically having a science-fiction theme.
definitions.ante: a stake put up by a player in poker or brag before receiving cards.
definitions.enema: a procedure in which fluid is injected into the rectum, typically to expel its contents.
definitions.inmate: a person living in an institution such as a prison or hospital.
definitions.intake: an amount, quantity, or group taken in.
definitions.ketamine: a synthetic compound used as an anaesthetic and analgesic drug and also illicitly as a hallucinogen.
definitions.kina: the basic monetary unit of Papua New Guinea, equal to 100 toea.
definitions.make: form by putting parts together or combining substances.
definitions.mane: a growth of long hair on the neck of a horse, lion, or other animal.
definitions.matinee: an afternoon performance in a theatre or cinema.
definitions.mean: intend to convey or refer to.
definitions.meat: the flesh of an animal (especially a mammal) as food.
definitions.name: a word or set of words by which someone or something is known, addressed, or referred to.
definitions.neat: in good order; tidy or carefully arranged.
definitions.take: reach for and hold with one's hands.
definitions.tame: (of an animal) not dangerous or frightened of people.
definitions.tank: a large receptacle or storage chamber, especially for liquid or gas.
definitions.teak: hard durable wood used in shipbuilding and for making furniture.
definitions.team: a group of players forming one side in a competitive game or sport.
